text:
alana: quick find from a 5-min usability check  deep-links land correctly but the left rail often stays collapsed and keyboard users lose the anchor. Breadcrumb sometimes shows a pre-redirect path which is confusing.

jess: can you list the exact pain points you hit?

alana: sure: 1) open deep-link to Org > Models > FooModel > Revisions 2) page body is focused but left rail still collapsed at "Models" 3) tabbing moves through header/controls with no visible nav highlight 4) breadcrumb reads "Models > ..." for a couple seconds then updates.

mike: sounds like router canonicalization + nav state reconciliation ordering issue.

sara: accessibility checklist: set aria-current on the revealed item, ensure role="link" is correct, provide a visible outline (not only color), and announce state change via aria-live politely. Respect prefers-reduced-motion for any expand animation.

tom: impl idea: on router:restored event -> reconcileRail(path) -> expand ancestors -> set aria-current on leaf -> focus leaf with element.focus({preventScroll:true}) -> if leaf not in rail viewport then railContainer.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}) or element.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'}). Also handle drawer mode by opening first.

jess: UX proposal: default behavior should preserve user-collapse for in-app navigations but auto-reveal for external deep-links. Add a user preference toggle "Always reveal left nav on external links" in Console Settings. For discoverability run a 5% experiment that shows an ephemeral toast: "Reveal in left nav" with a CTA, measuring click-through.

sara: for the live region text use short predictable phrasing: "Navigation: Models > FooModel revealed". Keep it aria-live=polite so it doesnt interrupt.

mike: test plan: unit test that aria-current toggles, e2e for desktop + mobile deep-link, a11y snapshot asserting presence of live region text after router restore. Also test that in-app nav preserves collapsed state.

jess: breadcrumb change: show last two meaningful segments and collapse the rest with an accessible affordance, e.g., "Org / ... / FooModel" and expose full path on hover/focus. Ensure separators are semantic (not just visuals).

tom: small perf note: avoid full rail DOM reflows on expand. Use CSS transforms for micro animation where possible and skip animation if prefers-reduced-motion.

ux-bot: Note added to design board: https://www.figma.com/file/xxx/rail-reveal-preferences (comment by @jess).

alana: consensus: implement reconcileRail on router restore + aria-current + focus with preventScroll; preserve user-collapse for internal navs; add preference and run small experiment with toast. Action items: eng (mike) implement, a11y (sara) add live region & tests, design (jess) update tokens + breadcrumb pattern. Ill file issue #4521 and open the PR. :thumbsup:
